senses.gloss: m. (comp. of שִׁית a. אסא, P. Sm. 291; v. אֲסִי) foundation.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 137:7">Targ. Ps. CXXXVII, 7</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="U02077"><he>שִׁתְּאֲסָא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 22:16">Ib. XXII, 16</cite> Ms. (differ. in ed.).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:16">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 16</cite>.
